scope: Current R2 ordinary setup journey with ongoing music and missing provider keys. Runtime follow-up only; no new semantic denominator or accepted checklist row.

method.native: Actual current main/storage, production renderer and preload in a disposable Electron process. Protected localhost connection and local state; no real account or media changes.
method.input: CUA only for all UI input. Playwright launches/reloads/closes and passively observes DOM, Audio events, IPC and persisted state. 1280x720 at 100% zoom.
method.substitutions: Local synthetic catalog and 40-second silent WAV; native media clock and natural repeat-one endings. Shared-key reader returns null, shared writes reject; external main fetches recorded and blocked. Output muted. No media time, rate, events or playback methods manipulated.
method.recordingCorrection: Initial recorder reload raced initial navigation and exited failed before the journey. Excluded initial-failed-report.json; recorder then waited for All songs before installing passive observation and reload. No product patch.

journey: Play restored paused Song 00002; open News bucket settings.
Draft interests and mood; create RSS source Science desk; return to setup, retain draft and focus on Manage sources; select the source.
Create Quiet & warm from a predefined preset without generating a preview; return with draft and focus on Manage DJs; select host and six-hour cadence.
Visit Albums and return to News bucket settings; fields remain drafted and profile remains unsaved.
Explicit Save setup stores all choices with preparation off. Save stays focused and disabled after success.
Open News bucket tab; focus moves to that tab and both off states remain visible.

observations.music: All six snapshots show Pause transport and unpaused native audio. Same queue, index, volume and repeat mode; recorded pauses only occur at natural 40-second endings followed by repeat.

requirementLinks.proof: Ongoing native playback through the recorded journey; no audible-quality claim.
Interests, mood, selected source/host and cadence survive the observed navigation and persist only on explicit profile save.
Successful Save retains focus; subsequent News bucket tab navigation wins. Pending/failure and other navigation variants not exercised here.
Missing provider keys do not prevent this configured-but-off save. Other incomplete-field combinations not exercised.
Both opt-ins remain off throughout this journey. Copy/switch and activation variants not exercised.

validation.observer: Exit 0, result observed, zero renderer errors. Owned fixture server stopped with exit 130.
validation.buildLint: No app code changed. Current app source matches PR135 validated build/type/lint source; intervening PR136 was documentation only. No repeated full build/lint or unit tests.
validation.ledger: Requirement text, exact fragments and all existing semantic/proof annotations remain unchanged. Evidence links identify partial examples, not whole-fragment acceptance.

limits: Controlled native setup journey, not live Jellyfin or a first-time-listener study. Silent muted media cannot establish audible quality.
No paid provider execution, preview generation, automatic preparation or DJ speech. getVoicePreview/getDJVoicePreview are cached metadata reads; preparePlayback is music stream preparation.
No pending/failure/retry/copy/switch/delete/readback-refresh variants. Prior dated evidence retains its own scope.
No smaller viewport, 200% zoom or native OS media-control acceptance.
